prompt: A calm flat paper-cut picture-book background in a strict handcraft design system: the whole image is ONE flat sheet of colored paper with a fine subtle paper grain, in a few harmonious tones of the palette below, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge. The back wall is a single flat plain sheet and the floor is a single flat plain sheet below a straight horizontal line - NO wavy bands, NO torn-paper strips, NO layered waves, NO patches or blotches on walls or floors. Only two or three simple meaningful objects, each cut from a few completely flat die-cut pieces with clean edges, no outlines, raised slightly so each casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown paper shadow onto the sheet behind it. Straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective, chunky simple shapes. Depth comes only from: back sheet, one middle layer, and soft drop shadows. Very large empty open space so characters will stand big in front. soft warm paper grain, a gentle darker floor band with a soft shadow line where wall meets floor, one small warm accent (lamp glow / window light) allowed. PALETTE (most important): a warm EVENING kitchen. The wall sheet is deep amber-brown, the floor sheet is dark brown, softly dim with a golden dusk glow from the stove, richer and darker than a daytime kitchen. Scene: a rich family traditional Korean kitchen at dusk: one flat plain amber-brown wall sheet and a flat plain dark brown floor sheet. Only three objects: one clay stove with two iron cauldrons at the LEFT, one wooden shelf on the wall in the middle-left, and one low table with a plate of white rice cakes (tteok) at the RIGHT. Open floor in the middle. No people. Soft muted picture-book colours, gentle light. No characters, no text, no watermark.
